description: This source file implements a factory for creating N2 connection clients, including local stub and SCTP-based clients, with associated notifiers for NGAP message handling and conversion between packed and unpacked NGAP PDUs, primarily for 5G network signaling.

classes.name: sctp_to_n2_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts incoming SCTP SDUs to NGAP messages and forwards them to the CU-CP.

classes.name: n2_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts NGAP messages to SCTP SDUs and forwards them to the SCTP gateway.

classes.name: ngap_gateway_local_stub
classes.description: A stub implementation of the N2 connection client for local testing without a core network.

classes.name: n2_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Handles SCTP connection to the network and manages message forwarding between NGAP and SCTP.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_connection_request
methods.description: Handles incoming connection requests from CU-CP, returning a notifier for NGAP message exchange.

methods.name: handle_tx_message
methods.description: Processes outgoing NGAP messages, including encoding and generating NG Setup responses.

methods.name: send_rx_pdu_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Encodes and forwards NGAP messages to the CU-CP, also writing to PCAP if enabled.
